explore.coast: I vote for a lake day! We can look out from Marblehead, watch for birds at Magee Marsh, or start wondering which island to visit next. ♡
explore.cities: Pick a city with me! I’m curious about Toledo’s glass, Dayton’s inventions, and the streets between the big landmarks. No need to rush—we have time.
explore.hills: My camera is ready, but I want us to look up from it, too. Let’s follow the sandstone, winding roads, and stories of Appalachian Ohio.
explore.wild: Shh… let’s give the woods a moment. I’d start with a short walk and see which sound, leaf, or bend in the stream makes us stop. ♡
explore.past: Come a little closer. I want us to take these histories seriously, listen to the people connected to them, and leave room for questions we can’t answer yet.
explore.symbols: A cardinal, a buckeye, that wonderfully unusual flag… I’m collecting little clues to Ohio. Which one would you recognize first?

make.factory: Hang on—before we admire the finished thing, I want to know how it got here. Shall we start with a cup, a tire, or a tiny brass whistle?
make.flight: A wind tunnel that makes ice?! Okay, you’ve got my attention. Come with me from the familiar shape of an airplane to the experiments behind it.
make.lab: I brought questions, which seems like the right thing to bring to a lab. Let’s follow what people are trying to understand, test, and make useful.
make.farm: I’m thinking about lunch already. But first, let’s follow the work between a field and our plates. There’s a whole chain of people to meet.
make.movement: That ship is only one chapter. I want to follow what happens after the dock: a crane, a train, a warehouse, and someone waiting at the other end. Let’s go!
make.work: Let’s keep the people in the picture. I’m interested in what gets made, but also in the jobs, households, and everyday decisions behind those numbers.

culture.records: I can’t choose just one soundtrack for Ohio. An orchestra tonight, another kind of stage next time? Come find a sound you want to stay with. ♡
culture.gallery: I’ll slow down here. A drawing, an earthwork, a museum object—each asks us to look differently. Tell me which detail caught your eye first.
culture.table: You did save room for a snack, right? I want to wander the market, hear what people recommend, and learn the story behind something delicious.
culture.game: I’m here for the people as much as the scoreboard. Let’s find out what brings everyone together, and what they keep talking about after the game. Hehe!
culture.words: Oopsie, some of these words deserve a second try. I’ll bring the pronunciation notes; you bring your curiosity. There’s more than one way to sound like Ohio.
culture.invention: A bicycle shop is a pretty wonderful place to begin a flight story. Come on—I want to follow the experiments before we get to the famous moment.

live.campus: I want to keep learning after the bell rings. A museum, a science center, a question from the trail… which kind of afternoon sounds like you?
live.library: Just one book? Ah, that’s an ambitious promise for me. Let’s see what the library can help us find, then follow whichever question gets bigger. ♡
live.civic: I’d rather start with one real question than memorize a whole chart. Come inside the Statehouse, then we can find out who does what and why it matters.
live.local: Let’s bring the map closer to home. I want to understand who looks after the places and services we notice every day in a neighborhood.
live.community: Here’s where I’d put down the itinerary for a while. Let’s meet the people tending a garden, organizing a gathering, or simply making room for a neighbor.
